question: Do the latest public XRP ETF flow aggregators support a single complete Nov 6 net-flow figure?
conclusion: No. Public aggregators report materially different Nov 6 results because their fund universes, issuer-file vintages, missing-fund treatment and flow derivations differ. Do not report a universal zero-flow result or combine the figures.

sources.source_summary: CryptoKeyhole's page update was 20:33 UTC on November 7. It reports only three of its four daily-tracked issuers for November 6: Bitwise and 21Shares at zero, Canary/XRPC down 752,048 XRP, and Franklin/XRPZ not yet published. sources.source_summary: XRP Insights reports a November 6 aggregate outflow of 663,043 XRP and a November 2–6 weekly outflow of 812,529 XRP across its six-spot-fund-plus-BITW universe. Its generated dataset contains 1,597 fund-day rows across 231 trading days and reports 1,195,787,657 XRP held. The publisher withholds GXRP flows because of a capture gap, includes XRPR with partly indirect ETP exposure, includes BITW whose XRP sleeve can change through index rebalancing, and documents reconstructed historical rows.

source_scope_reconciliation.alpha_finance: Five tickers: XRP, XRPZ, XRPC, GXRP and TOXR; zero aggregate USD flow on Nov 6.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The Nov 6 XRPC redemption/outflow is real; the apparent zero from Alpha Finance is caused by its different/undisclosed feed, fund scope, vintage or update handling.
supporting_evidence: CryptoKeyhole and XRP Insights both report an XRPC change of -752,048 XRP in their rendered views.
disconfirming_evidence: The direct issuer file was not fetched in this run; both aggregators can still share stale or misinterpreted source data.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The aggregators are measuring different things and no single total can be selected without reconstructing the same issuer-level holdings universe.
supporting_evidence: Five-fund Alpha scope; four-fund CryptoKeyhole daily scope; six spot plus BITW XRP Insights scope; different treatment of GXRP, XRPR and BITW.
disconfirming_evidence: The XRPC -752,048 XRP value appears in two independently processed issuer-holdings-based aggregators.

competing_hypotheses.statement: Holdings changes are an imperfect proxy for net creations/redemptions and may include fees, index rebalancing, indirect ETP holdings or capture-gap corrections.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights explicitly documents BITW rebalancing/fees, XRPR indirect exposure, GXRP capture-gap exclusion and reconstructed historical rows.
disconfirming_evidence: For some direct spot funds, issuer-reported daily holdings changes can still provide a useful flow proxy after same-fund vintage and coverage controls.

reasons: No common fund universe across providers.
Nov 6 CryptoKeyhole data is explicitly partial.
CryptoKeyhole contains an internal future-dated issuer-file label.
Alpha Finance does not disclose fund AUM/holdings or upstream source lineage in the captured page.
XRP Insights includes indirect/index exposure and known flow exclusions/reconstruction caveats.
Raw issuer files and original HTTP response bytes were not captured directly in this run.
